label: Regime · bearish votes
gloss: how many of the four momentum inputs voted bearish (0–4) — read against the bullish tally, a 3–1 is not a 2–1

label: Regime · bullish votes
gloss: how many of the four momentum inputs voted bullish (0–4)

label: Regime · run length
gloss: consecutive confirmed bars the structure label has held, unbounded — a warning or a volatility move inside it does not restart it; unresolved while the run’s start is unknown, across a bar the platform never classified or before the label next changes after a cold start

label: Regime · state
gloss: the market structure the platform classified — trend or range, up or down — at the confirmed close; its volatility and warnings are read beside it

label: Regime · trend
gloss: the platform-classified trend regime

label: Regime · trend gate
gloss: whether this bar cleared the ADX trending gate (27), dropped below the exit gate (23), or landed in the buffer between them where the PREVIOUS bar’s trend is carried forward rather than re-confirmed

label: Regime · trend margin
gloss: ADX points by which the current trend label survives — distance above the exit gate (23) while trending, below the entry gate (27) while ranging; small inside the buffer zone

label: Regime · trend source
gloss: which evidence class voted the trend direction — a decisive DI spread, or the EMA(21)/EMA(55) alignment fallback that fires precisely when the DI spread is indecisive

label: Regime · volatility
gloss: the platform-classified volatility regime

label: Regime · ATR ratio
gloss: the classifier’s ATR reading against its own trailing-window mean; expands above 1.05, contracts below 0.9

label: Regime · BB-width ratio
gloss: the classifier’s Bollinger-width reading against its own trailing-window mean; the volatility label needs THIS and the ATR ratio to agree, so either alone can hold it back

label: Regime · crash warning
gloss: whether the reading carries the crash warning: raised by a crash reading below the gate (-3) and held by the crash latch until the reading recovers to the exit gate

label: Regime · divergence warning
gloss: whether the reading carries the momentum-divergence warning: momentum diverging from price while the structure is a trend

label: ROC (12)
gloss: rate of change vs 12 bars ago (%)

label: ROC (15)
gloss: rate of change vs 15 bars ago (%)

label: ROC (9)
gloss: rate of change vs 9 bars ago (%)

label: RSI (14)
gloss: 14-period relative strength index (0–100)

label: RSI (2)
gloss: 2-period relative strength index (0–100) — the Connors mean-reversion horizon

label: RSI (7)
gloss: 7-period relative strength index (0–100)

label: Sell quote volume
gloss: the bar's sell-side traded notional, in USD: the sum of each taker sell's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

label: Sell trades
gloss: the bar's sell trade count

label: Sell volume
gloss: the bar's sell-side traded volume, in base-asset units

label: Settled at
gloss: the settlement timestamp of the reference game

label: SMA (20)
gloss: 20-period simple moving average

label: SMA (200)

label: SMA (50)

label: Smart vs retail
gloss: divergence between flow pressure and crowd bias — hidden accumulation when buyPres_now > 0.6 and upLeanZ is at most −1.96; hidden distribution when buyPres_now < 0.4 and upLeanZ is at least 1.96; confirmed when buyPres_now > 0.6 and upLeanZ is at least 1.96, or buyPres_now < 0.4 and upLeanZ is at most −1.96; compared on the unrounded score; no value otherwise

label: Spot avg trade
gloss: the composite spot volume per trade in the bar's period, over the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase), in this coin's own unit; absent where one of those venues did not cover the period or nothing traded

label: Spot close (Binance)
gloss: Binance spot close of the bar's period, USDT-quoted, expressed in this coin's own unit (a k-prefixed ticker such as kPEPE denotes 1000 base tokens, and the venue price is scaled to match so it compares with the mark): Binance's last trade in the period, or the price it carried through every minute of a period with no trade; absent where any minute of the period went unseen (missed by Binance's feed and not recovered from its trade history), or where the coin did not trade on Binance in the period and its price was not carried through every minute of it (its last trade older than the coin's spot-tape freshness target, at least 15 minutes, or the minute before the period unpriced); a forming bar's close older than that target is absent
